blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26098754, Base block 52041959 and Arbitrum block 510719674. Ethereum sendSharesGate() and receiveSharesGate() are zero; abdicated(selector) is true and timelock(selector) is 604800 seconds for both share-gate setters. The exact deployed VaultV2 source prevents execution of abdicated functions. sendAssetsGate() and receiveAssetsGate() are also zero, but the send-assets gate setter is not abdicated and retains a seven-day timelock, so permissionless share transfer does not prove immutable redemption access. Base MetaMorpho and Arbitrum MetaMorphoV1_1 retain ordinary ERC-20 share transfers in their exact verified sources. Native chain-local USDC asset() and zero EIP-1967 slots were confirmed across all three vaults. Freeze exposure remains inherited from usdc-circle; no upstream blacklist or pause exposure is removed.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (R2WCircle), exact three-deployment source and pinned gate review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The three registered contracts are distinct, independently priced ERC-4626 vault products, not fungible deployments of one cross-chain gtUSDCp liability. Each vault issues and burns its own shares against local USDC without canonical gtUSDCp escrow. The Prime brand alone does not establish that all same-name vaults belong in this asset. Current CoinGecko identity gauntlet-usdc-prime names only Ethereum V2, while this catalog also retains Base V1 and Arbitrum V1.1; the older Ethereum V1 is separately registered as gtusdc-gauntlet. The prior complete-family inventory and transfer-census eligibility conclusion is withdrawn. Re-admission is deferred pending a reconciled catalog liability scope and evidence that its deployment set and published aggregate are complete for that scope.
